description:
We are seeking qualified candidates in the San Francisco, CA, USA area who have strong experience as a software engineer, particularly with a focus on backend development and API design. Ideal applicants will demonstrate a robust track record in building scalable server‑side systems, designing clean and well‑documented APIs, and collaborating across engineering teams.

Compensation for this role is competitive, with a salary range from $120,000 up to $180,000 annually, reflecting the level of expertise and impact we expect from successful hires.
